_comment: Copy to overrides.json (gitignored) and edit. Every key is a thread's ORIGINAL name from timeline.json. include: name -> id of a project on the map (any depth). fate: one of shipped, active, parked, half-done, abandoned, superseded, unknown. successor: name -> successor thread's original name, or null to drop a guess. note: name -> your own short note, shown on the Line view. image: name -> image path relative to the map page (e.g. images/x.jpg; stage-preview.sh copies marginalia/images/). gitUmbrella (Git view only): repo path prefix under ~/work -> map umbrella id, for repos Marginalia's tree doesn't place under an umbrella; longest prefix wins.

note.<thread name>: <a sentence in your own words: why it stopped, what it taught you>
